description: Queer and trans people deserve to be safe and respected in every space and at every stage of life. But Trump and right-wing extremists have made it their mission to vilify queer and trans people and strip them of basic protections. This campaign of hate has fueled a new wave of harassment, discrimination, and hardship for LGBTQIA+ communities. What’s worse is that many Democrats have suggested abandoning queer and trans people for short-term political gain, a strategy that is both morally indefensible and ineffective.
